application_credentials.description:
Follow the [Application Credentials instructions]({more_info_url}) to configure OAuth for the YouTube Data API v3.

1. Go to the [Google API Console]({oauth_creds_url}) and create (or select) a project.
2. Enable the **YouTube Data API v3**.
3. Configure the OAuth consent screen (external, add your own Google account as a test user, add scope `.../auth/youtube.readonly`).
4. Create OAuth client ID credentials of type **Web application**.
5. Add `{redirect_url}` as an authorized redirect URI.
6. Enter the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** below.
